Commentary.Commentary: We are set for the chase to get underway! The players of New Zealand stride out to the middle. Aaron Finch and David Warner walk out to bat for Australia. Tim Southee to start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Australia would not be too disappointed with the kind of show they put up. All the bowlers except for Mitchell Marsh had quite a good outing and picked up wickets. Kane Richardson picked 3, Adam Zampa picked 2 and they were very economical. Ashton Agar and Mitchell Starc picked 1 each and they too were not too expensive. Marsh though had a tough game as he went for 53 in his 4 overs. But, he will likely have a big role to play in their chase. What will happen in the second half? Stay with us to find out.

New Zealand had a good start provided by their top order. Kane Williamson, Daryl Mitchell and Martin Guptill got starts at the top of the order and gave them a good platform. There was a bit of a collapse in the middle order but James Neesham scored 31 in just 18 balls to take the Kiwis to a good score. They would back themselves to defend this.
It has been a good show by New Zealand with the bat. The pitch is a slowish one and they have put on a good score. Australia too would be happy as most of their bowlers had a good outing.
OUT! TAKEN! RIchardson ends with a wicket and NEW ZEALAND HAVE BEEN RESTRICTED TO 158! A short one on middle, this is heaved towards wide long on. The fielder runs to his left and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Another dot! Drags the length back, bowls a slower one. This one holds in the wicket. Neesham swings but it sneaks under the bat.
SIX! This time he clears the fence! New Zealand needed this! Fuller and on middle, This is heaved over the long on fence for a biggie.
Swing and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Neesham looks to pull but misses.
Kyle Jamieson walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Richardson has bowled really well and he gets his second. Full and wide outside off. Bowling to his field. Southee lofts it high up in the air, it is more off the bottom and Agar in the deep takes a good catch. The Kiwis have lost their way here.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Dropped! If you want to call it one! A low full toss, this is hammered back towards the bowler. Richardson tries to catch but it bursts through the hands and goes behind for one.
James Neesham backs away at the last moment. Kane Richardson had already left go the ball and is not amused.
A low full toss, this is pushed down to long off for one. Brilliant 19th over. Just the 6 from it.
Just the one again! On the pads, this is whipped through square leg for one. Can Starc end the over well? 150 up for the Kiwis.
Mistimed! A full toss on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Another yorker on off, this is jammed out towards cover for one.
Just the one again! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.
A yorker on off, Southee jams it out towards the off side for a quick run.
FOUR! SHOT! Short ball, around middle. James Neesham stays back and pulls it past deep square leg for a boundary.
Tim Southee is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! That is an excellent piece of fielding in the deep by Steven Smith! Good-length ball, around off. Mitchell Santner hoicks it in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Steven Smith there settles under it and takes the catch. The momentum was taking him over the ropes so he lobs the ball to Ashton Agar who comes running from deep square leg. Agar does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Richardson bangs it into the deck, around leg. Neesham pulls it towards deep square leg for one.
Wide! Full ball, way outside off. James Neesham looks to slog but he misses. Wided!
FOUR! EDGY! Full ball, outside off. James Neesham looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge and into the third man fence.
Slower ball, shorter in length, around off. James Neesham looks to pull but he gets an underedge and the ball dabs onto the pitch.
Full ball, outside off. Mitchell Santner moves across and drives it to deep cover for a run.
Kane Richardson is back on. He went for 6 in his first two overs.
A dot to end! A magical over by Agar! Fires it outside off, Neesham looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Just the one! On middle, Santner pushes it down to long on for one.
Make that 3 dots and a wicket in this over so far! On middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Another one on middle, Santner flicks but to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

OUT! TIMBER! Agar gets his first and a welcome wicket for him! Angled into the leg pole. Glenn Phillips looks to play the slog sweep but misses. This one hits the leg pole. Mitchell Santner walks out to bat.
Ashton Agar is going to bowl out. 3-0-33-0 for him so far.
Just a single to end! On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Another slower short ball, Phillips looks to pull but misses.
Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
A slower short ball, Neesham looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Thumped! Fuller and on off, Neesham hammers it past the bowler, very straight. Smith runs to his left and dives but fails to stop it.
SIX! That is huge! Marsh has had a forgetful day with the ball so far! Fuller and on middle, this is heaved over the long on fence for a biggie.
A dot to end! Another good over for the Aussies! On middle, this is jammed back to the bowler.
Neesham is off the mark! Shorter and on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
James Neesham walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Mitchell Starc gets the big wicket of Conway and New Zealand lose another! Starc hurls a full ball on the pads, around leg. Devon Conway misses his flick and gets rapped in front. Mitchell Starc puts in an appeal and up goes the finger.
FOUR! Deft! Nice and fine! Length and on off, Conway plays it late and fine on the off side. This one races away to the fence. Lovely deft touch and a welcome boundary.
Short of a length, just outside off. Glenn Phillips taps it to wide of point and gets off the mark with one.
Back of a length, around off. Devon Conway pushes it to mid on and takes a single.
Mitchell Starc is back on.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler. Brilliant over by Zampa, just what his team needed.
Glenn Phillips is the new batter.

OUT! TIMBER! Big wicket and timely one! Williamson was really finding the boundaries at ease! The slog sweep is out, he played the right shot as it was the googly, it lands outside off and turns back in. Williamson misses and it hits the stumps.
Third dot in the over! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped but to covers.
Just the one as this is pushed through covers.
Two dots in a row! The reverse sweep comes out but can't get it past point.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
FOUR! Too short and it is put away! On middle, this is pulled over square leg for a boundary by Kane Williamson.
FOUR! Up and over! Lovely! Floats it up on middle, Williamson makes room and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
The sweep comes out, does not time it that well, it goes through square leg for one.
Tossed up on off, Conway plays it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air and on off, this is pushed to covers for one.
On the pads, Conway works it through mid-wicket for one.
Change. Ashton Agar is back on. He went for 22 in his first two overs.
A miss! Shorter and on middle, Williamson looks to play the paddle scoop but misses.
A slower one on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Williamson comes down the track, the length is shortened, it is slapped through covers for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers for one.
A leave! Do not see that often! Outside off, left alone.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Outside off, Williamson guides it to short third man for one. A tidy over from Zampa.
Williamson misses out! A full toss on middle, he plays it gently back to the bowler.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled down to long on for one.
Just the one again as this is whipped down to the long on fielder.
Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

Drinks break! This has been a good start by New Zealand and they would look to put on a big score from here. The platform is set for them to tee off in the last few overs now. Here comes Devon Conway out to bat and replace Daryl Mitchell. Adam Zampa is back on.
FOUR! Nicely done by Daryl Mitchell! Starc bangs it into the deck, around middle and leg. Mitchell hangs back and pulls it to wide of deep square leg for a boundary. 11 runs off the over!
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell makes room to slog it but he fails to get any bat on it.
Good-length ball, around leg. Kane Williamson tucks it to the leg side and collects one.
FOUR! Top shot! Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Kane Williamson gets low and lofts it over cover for a boundary.
Length ball, angling in from middle and leg. Daryl Mitchell gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls away and they take a run.
Full ball, around middle. Kane Williamson eases it to long on for a single.
Two more to end! Outside off, this is played through point for two.
FOUR! Daryl Mitchell joins the act now. He plays the reverse sweep, gets it through point. Another boundary.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! The reverse sweep from Williamson! Very uncharacteristic from him but it comes off. On middle, he nails it through point. This one races away to the fence.
Flatter and on middle, holds its line. Defended.
FOUR! That is sheer timing! Beautiful! Shorter and outside off, this is guided past point. Boundary results. Well played by Kane Williamson.
Ashton Agar (1-0-7-0) is back on.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, Williamson comes down the track and cuts it past point. Two taken.
Two more! Yet another half volley, this is driven through covers for two.
Outside off and shorter, this is slapped through covers for one.
Better from Marsh! A slower one, fuller and outside off, Mitchell looks to go downtown but is beaten.
SIX! This is poor from Marsh! He has just not got his line right. A half volley on the pads again, this is whipped over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Mitchell Marsh comes back to bowl.
A dot to end! Good fielding! Williamson comes down the track and looks to push it past cover. Warner dives and stops it.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Williamson now plays the paddle sweep towards that region for one.
Now the paddle sweep, just for one as it goes to fine leg.
FOUR! Lovely shot! The reverse sweep comes out, Mitchell plays it fine and this one races away to the third man fence.
That is poor cricket all around! A full toss, Williamson is taken by surprise. He pushes it back gently to Zampa who lets it through for one.

Another slower one on middle, Williamson is early in the pull, he then plays it towards short fine leg for one. A really good 6th from Kane. New Zealand are 47 for 1 after the Powerplay. Good one for them.
Once again fails to time it! Shorter and outside off, Williamson hops and tries to cut but underedges it to covers.
Another one on a length and around off, Williamson plays it late but can't get it past the keeper. Another dot.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Williamson looks to flick but misses.

Big confusion! Williamson steps out, the length is shortened. He plays it to covers. The fielder has a needless shy at the bowler's end but misses. The fielder backing up fumbles. Williamson wants one but is sent back in time.
Good length and on off, blocked.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Kane Williamson walks out to bat. Also, Kane Richardson comes back into the attack.
OUT! LBW! As plumb as it gets! Flatter ball, on middle. Guptill goes for the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal and up goes the finger.
A googly, around off. Heaved to long on for one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Daryl Mitchell guides it to point.
A full one, on leg. Guptill hits it to long on for one.
Just a single as this is hit to long on.
Tossed up, on off. Daryl Mitchell goes for the drive but gets the outside edge to point.
Adam Zampa comes to bowl.
SIX! Bang! That is out of here! On middle, fuller, this is heaved over the long on fence by Martin Guptill. This is probably the momentum shifting over.
FIVE WIDES! This is turning out to be just the over New Zealand needed! Way down the leg side, Guptill lets it be, the keeper fails to collect it. It goes to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! All of a sudden, boundaries are flowing. Another one on the pads, this is whipped over square leg. Boundary.
Two more! Short and on middle, Guptill pulls it over square leg, two taken.
FOUR! Another boundary! On the pads, this is pulled fine on the leg side. Races away to the fence. Back-to-back boundaries for Martin Guptill.
FOUR! Nicely played! Angled into the pads, Guptill flicks it over square leg. Boundary.
Good-length ball, on the pads. Martin Guptill clips it to square leg.
Mitchell Marsh comes into the attack.
Another one! So a good comeback by the bowler after going for a boundary early on. On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
The quicker one and on middle, Mitchell gets his bat down in time and pushes it to covers.
Quick run! On off, Guptill pushes it to covers for one.
Just short! Floats it up on off, Gutpill plays it uppishly but short of mid off.
FOUR! Nicely played and a welcome boundary! Just used the pace, flatter and outside off. Guptill cuts it past point. This one races away to the fence.
Ashton Agar comes to bowl.
Good length and angling into the batter, Mitchell looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Another quick run! On middle, Guptill plays it to covers for one.
In the air... safe! Shorter and outside off. Daryl Mitchell looks to cut, it comes slow off the surface, it goes high up in the air over covers for one.
Quick run! On off, Guptill guides it to point and takes one.
A slower one, fuller and on off, Guptill looks to go down the ground but it goes more off the toe end towards mid on. .
Good length and on middle, kept out.
Who will bowl from the other end? Kane Richardson it is.
A dot to end! An action-packed first over by Starc! Fuller and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot to get off the mark! Beautifull! Fuller and on middle, Mitchell strokes it past the bowler, straight down the ground for the first boundary.

Lovely stuff from Starc! Got the last one to angle away and gets this one back in. Slightly straighter then he would have liked. Guptill looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.

There was a sound! The umpire shakes his head though. Starc can't believe it. He felt there is an edge. Fuller and outside off, a tempter, Guptill looks to drive but is beaten. There is a sound as the ball passes the bat but maybe it was off the bat hitting the ground.
WIDE! Looks to angle this one across but it is short and quite wide. Left alone. Wided.
Some inward movement, fuller and on middle, Guptill plays it with the movement to mid-wicket.

BEATEN! What a beauty to start with! Length around off, this one seems to be coming back in but then holds its line after bouncing. Guptill pays inside the line and is beaten. An appeal but turned down.

We are set for the game to begin! The players of Australia make their way out to the middle. Martin Guptill and Daryl Mitchell walk out to bat for New Zealand. Mitchell Starc will start with the ball.

Australia - Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins, Aaron Finch (C), Josh Hazlewood, Josh Inglis, Mitchell Marsh, Glenn Maxwell, Kane Richardson, Steven Smith, Mitchell Starc, Marcus Stoinis, Mitchell Swepson, Matthew Wade (WK), David Warner, Adam Zampa.
New Zealand - Martin Guptill, Daryl Mitchell, Trent Boult, Todd Astle, Devon Conway (WK), Kyle Jamieson, James Neesham, Glenn Phillips, Mitchell Santner, Ish Sodhi, Tim Southee, Kane Williamson (C).
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and they will BOWL first.
... Match Day ...

The Trans-Tasman rivals begin their preparation for the WC by facing each other in a warm-up game. Both the sides have not played a lot of cricket in recent times. Also, not many of their played a major role in the recently concluded Indian T20 League as well. This is a good chance for most of the players to acclamation to the conditions and get an idea of what could be their best XI for the mega event. Yes, this is a practice game but we believe both would be eager to beat the other here. Welcome to the coverage.
